nodes.label: Medieval Tribal Societies
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Many subcontinent societies did not follow Brahmanical rules or divide into unequal classes. United by kinship bonds. Obtained livelihood from agriculture, hunting-gathering or herding. Controlled land jointly.

nodes.label: Shifting Cultivation
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Method where trees and bushes are cut and burnt, crops sown in ashes. When soil loses fertility, another plot is cleared. Practised by Gonds and other forest-dwelling tribal communities.

nodes.label: Nomadic Pastoralists
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Mobile people who moved long distances with animals, living on milk and pastoral products. Exchanged wool, ghee with settled agriculturists. Included Gaddis in the western Himalaya.
